subject: English
passage: When marine biologists Dr. Suman Kelkar and Dr. Gustavo Teixeira began studying coral reef ecosystems in 2019, one of their primary objectives was to develop a monitoring system that could track reef health in real time. ______ they designed an underwater sensor network that continuously measures water temperature, pH levels, and coral bleaching indicators across multiple reef sites.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. "To that end" logically signals that the information in this sentence—the scientists' design of a real-time monitoring sensor network—is the product of a goal or desire in the previous sentence (the scientists' objective to develop a real-time reef monitoring system).
